title.en: Quantum teleportation with imperfect joint measurements
title.ko: 불완전한 공동 측정에서의 양자 텔레포테이션 연구

summary.en: Jeonghyeon Shin, Jaehak Lee, Soojoon Lee, and Seung-Woo Lee’s article “Quantum teleportation with partially entangled joint measurements induced by coherent errors” was published in Physical Review A 114, 042401. This entry records the publication; the journal page provides the full details.
summary.ko: 신정현, Jaehak Lee, Soojoon Lee, 이승우의 논문 “Quantum teleportation with partially entangled joint measurements induced by coherent errors”가 Physical Review A 114, 042401에 출판되었습니다. 출판 사실을 기록한 항목이며 자세한 내용은 저널 원문에서 확인할 수 있습니다.
